messages:
harper: FYI my PR updating SDK snippets hit docs preview failures (md-lint + link-check) and is blocked from merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8530

lee: Can you paste the CI summary?

ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #8530 failures: md-lint: 1 line-length violation in sdk/snippets/python.md; link-checker: 1 broken anchor (guides/auth.md -> #oauth-flow). Full logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/preview/8530

harper: The broken anchor came from renaming a section in guides/auth.md. I changed "OAuth flow" -> "OAuth authentication flow" which changed the slug.

toni: Quick plan: 1) update link target in the snippet file to the new slug (#oauth-authentication-flow) 2) shorten the long code comment line to satisfy md-lint. I can open a tiny follow-up patch.

harper: That would be great, thanks. Also, can someone rerun the preview after? I don't have rerun perms.

docs-bot: Rerun hint: comment `@docs-bot rerun-preview` on the PR or run `/docs preview rerun 8530` here.

lee: I'll review the follow-up once it's up. Toni, tag me when ready.

toni: Pushed fix branch `fix/8530-links-mdlint`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8531 — updated the anchor and wrapped the long comment.

lee: Reviewed and approved. One tiny nit on wording in the snippet but not blocking.

harper: Nit fixed in 8531. @docs-bot rerun-preview

ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PRs #8530 and #8531. Jobs: link-checker, md-lint.

ci-bot: docs-preview: run complete  all checks passed for PR #8530 and PR #8531. ✅

harper: Thanks all — merging during the next docs merge window (15:30 UTC). Please ping if anything else pops up.

toni: Nice, quick turnaround :thumbsup:
